QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` off (the default; the option is commented out in `mbedtls_config.h:208`) | macros for `calloc` / `free`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that in the default build (PLATFORM_MEMORY off), mbedtls_calloc and mbedtls_free are macros for calloc and free, so there is no indirection.
